description: This Kotlin source file defines a 'MatchDetailsFragment' class which is a UI component used in an Android application. It displays details of a sports match, including teams, scores, and highlights, and handles user interactions such as playing highlight videos.

classes.name: MatchDetailsFragment
classes.description: A fragment that shows detailed information about a sports match, including teams, score, league, start time, and highlight video options.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, loads match data from arguments, and sets up the UI components and adapters.

classes.name: DetailsDescriptionPresenter
classes.description: A presenter for the details overview row, displaying the match title and a prompt to watch highlights.

classes.name: DetailsInfo
classes.description: A data class containing match info text along with URLs for home and away team logos.

classes.name: DetailsInfoPresenter
classes.description: A presenter that binds match info and team logos to views, loading images asynchronously.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates view holders for displaying match info and logos.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds match info and loads team logos asynchronously into views.

methods.name: onUnbindViewHolder
methods.description: Handles cleanup when viewholders are unbound.
